profile.headline: Senior Audio Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Senior Audio Software Engineer with 10+ years of expertise in high-performance C++ and real-time systems. Architeched audio engines, mixers, and cross platform audio plugin frameworks. From presenting at ADC to shipping revenue-critical products at Universal Audio, I combine deep technical rigor with a musician’s intuition to build stable, scalable infrastructure designed to last decades.

positions.title: Audio Engineer
positions.description: Contract engineer, offering tracking, mixing, and live sound services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Audio Application Dev: Wrote the audio engine for Paradise Guitar Studio. Architected VST3/AU/AAX versions of UADx native audio plugins using C++ and JUCE. Implemented long awaited UADx plugin features like resizable GUIs, compressor sidechain support, native Win32 support (with HiDPI), and Apple Silicon support, as well as preset browser GUI/UX and backend improvements. Implemented VST3 support for UAD2 DSP plugins. Also designed the MIDI packet library for the UA DAW (LUNA) in the UADx SDK and decryption-over-bluetooth support for bonus feature access in our Linux-based UAFX guitar pedals.

Audio Tools Dev: Developed Python, bash, and JUCE GUI and command line tools for plugin development, DSP prototyping, and developer testing that quickened the pace of plugin development and lowered QA regression testing overhead

Build and Integration Dev: Maintained cross platform (ARM/Intel macOS, embedded Linux, Windows)  plugin build/PACE-powered DRM/deployment systems with Bamboo CI driven by internal Python and CMake libraries

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of the sound dept, wrote the JAM audio scripting engine to assist with some of the pain points of composers in my department. The engine was used in two shipped titles, Bierhaus and Sword of Destiny.

Beyond audio, I developed real-time WebGL shaders to replace video assets for Sword of Destiny, reducing memory footprint and download time significantly.

Developed Qt GUI tools for sound designers and artists to create game assets

Engineered voiceover recording sessions at the in-house studio using Pro Tools

positions.title: Sound Reinforcement Engineer
positions.description: Engineered and recorded live performances at the DePaul University School of Music

positions.title: Sound Designer / Audio Programmer (Contract)
positions.description:
Responsible for all spatial audio creation and implementation in virtual reality Oculus Solitaire in Unity using C#

Composed and sound designed for an iOS/Android title, Rogue Racing, implemented all audio using proprietary C++ game engine

volunteerExperiences.description: Once a week I help in the vet clinic coordinating dog medications and walk/train stray dogs as they await adoption.

Worked with high school aged youth at an after school program at the Sacred Heart Music Center venue and recording studio in Minnesota to learn how to be in local bands. Covered promotion, making the best use of recording time, how to book gigs, and songwriting skills.

projects.title: UADx Guitar Amp Plugins
projects.description: Designed a C++ audio algorithm chaining architecture and parameter mapping engine to power "multi plugins" such as the Dream 65 Fender simulation, Ruby 63 Vox simulation, Lion 68 Marshall Plexi plugin. Expanded to power the Paradise Guitar Studio suite. The technology I developed included a multi-rate/multithreaded realtime C++ audio engine, a parameter mapping engine, assignable parameter slots, VST3/AU/AAX support, unit and integration test harnesses, and profiling and debugging tooling.

projects.title: UAD Spark / UADx Plugin Platform
projects.description:
Architected VST3/AU/AAX versions of UAD Spark native audio plugins and virtual instruments. Includes platform specific web renderer for GUI (using macOS WebKit Objective-C APIs and Microsoft WebView2 COM APIs) and plugin wrapper layer written in C++/JUCE. 

Ported UADx plugin hosting to Windows and Apple Silicon.

Designed and implemented resizable plugin GUIs for UADx.

Maintained the UADx preset browser application using JUCE. Upgraded the underlying library to be more testable, allowing for TDD to be applied for new features. Implemented a user preference system and A/B compare.

Also worked on automated test tooling for the product in Python and helped with Bamboo CI infrastructure for building, tests, and deployment.
